description: Talaix Data Observatory — the data registry. Catalog records of datasets: status integrated | candidate | rejected. 'integrated' means the source is wired into a live pipeline path (status_note says where); 'candidate' means catalogued for evaluation — nothing is wired to it; 'rejected' means evaluated and declined with reason. Entries carry no implication of use unless status=integrated. Built 2026-08-17 from config/source_registry.json (29 source entries transformed; the two dual-dataset entries — EU-DEM+SRTM terrain, FIRMS VIIRS+MODIS, OSM ohsome+Overpass — were split into one record per dataset+access path, giving 32 transformed records) plus 23 new authoritative global candidates. Extended 2026-08-17 (second pass) with 12 further national-service candidates (eccc, saws, ncm-uae, inmet, smn-mexico, smn-argentina, dmc-chile, senamhi, marocmeteo, ncm-saudi, mss-singapore, bmkg — URLs reachability-checked at audit date, results in each entry's provenance) and data_quality_profile objects on every integrated entry (freshness/completeness/resolution/provenance/validation/coverage/licensing — facts from the entry itself; candidates carry no profile: nothing is wired to them). Extended 2026-09-03 (global open-data pass): +94 catalog records — global/regional data catalogues and national open-data portals (EU, US, UK, FR, DE, ES, CA, AU, JP, KR, IN, BR, MX, SA, QA, JO, MA, TN, openAFRICA), international organisations (World Bank, IMF, OECD, Eurostat, UN, ILO, FAO, UNHCR, WHO, UN WPP, BIS, ECB), hazard & disaster archives (EM-DAT, DesInventar, ThinkHazard, PreventionWeb, EMSC, GEM, ISC, GVP, NOAA Storm Events, IBTrACS, IFRC GO, ACLED, UCDP, GTD, USDM, EDO, GDACS multi-hazard), new earth-observation sources (GOES-R, EUMETSAT, Himawari, ALOS-2, GPM IMERG, SMAP, GRACE-FO, SWOT, VIIRS night lights, Planetary Computer, OpenTopography, NASADEM, Copernicus Marine, CHIRPS, AWS Open Data), climate (CMIP6, IPCC Atlas, NOAA GML, Climate TRACE, WRI Aqueduct, Berkeley Earth), environment (GBIF, IUCN, WDPA, OpenAQ, E-PRTR, HydroSHEDS, GEMStat, SoilGrids, GEBCO, EMODnet, GEOGLOWS, Overture Maps), energy/economy (GEM, Ember, IEA, IRENA, ENTSO-E, EIA, OPSD) and evidence/knowledge (OpenCorporates, OpenSanctions, GLEIF, SEC EDGAR, Wikidata, Crossref, OpenAlex, OWID) — all candidates (nothing wired), URLs reachability-checked 2026-09-03 except four national portals (govdata-de, data-gov-sa, data-gov-qa, data-gov-jo) where the check failed from the audit network (noted in their provenance). Also integrated: landsat-c2-l2 (USGS/NASA Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 via Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC) as the optical-satellite fallback in fetch_satellite_data, verified end-to-end 2026-09-03. New candidates carry a catalog_group label for registry navigation.
